entities.summary: Jakub Lauko is a Czech professional ice hockey forward for HC Dynamo Pardubice of the Czech Extraliga (ELH). The Boston Bruins selected him in the third round, 77th overall, of the 2018 NHL entry draft. Lauko has also played for the Minnesota Wild, before being reacquired by the Bruins.
